commitResults.messageTitle: Add combined daily nutrition totals to DayPlan
commitResults.messageBody:
Daily nutrition totals are available through four separate getters.
Add calculateDailyNutritionTotals() to return all four values in an
immutable NutritionTotals record, making them easier to use together.

Reuse the existing getters to avoid duplicating calculation logic.
Document units and empty-day behavior, and retain long values for
totals that exceed the integer range.

Add seven tests covering normal meals, empty days, zero nutrition,
repeated meals, large values, and independent daily totals.

Validation: All tests and Checkstyle checks pass with Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Warn when meal plans exceed nutrition targets
commitResults.messageBody:
Generated plans can exceed exact nutrition targets while remaining
within the accepted 15% tolerance, without alerting the user.

view-plan. Keep the existing generation tolerance unchanged.

Add boundary, overflow, replacement, and console integration tests.
Update Javadocs and the User and Developer Guides.

Validate with Java 25: all 601 tests and both Checkstyle checks pass.
